messages:
Lina (sec-engineer): Observed ~2.3k TLS handshake failures across edge proxies in eu-west-1 since 08:12 UTC. Errors show TLS alert 40 and `client cert rejected` in envoy logs. Happening right after the RBAC rule change that tightened service identities.
Raj (platform): can you paste an example log line? is this only ingress or also east-west?
Lina (sec-engineer): ingress only so far. example snippet: `envoy[1234]: TLS error: client cert rejected, peer_subject=CN=svc-collector,OU=prod, error=role-missing`
Aisha (infra): i also see a correlated spike of KMS decrypt errors for cert-rotator in ap-south-1: `KMSDecryptDenied: access denied to key alias/rotator/ap-south` — could be an IAM policy mismatch from the RBAC rollout influencing the rotator service role.
ops-bot: ALERT: cert-rotator-decrypt-failures increased by 580% in ap-south-1 (metric cert_rotator.kms.decrypt_failures > 100/min).
Maya (oncall): rolling back RBAC change to previous policy is safest short-term. Raj, can you revert the change and re-evaluate?
Raj (platform): rolling back now. patch id rbac/2024-09-03-v3 -> reverting to v2. deploying in eu-west-1 and ap-south-1 (canary first).
Evan (sre): in parallel we should add richer audit fields to the proxy logs (client.subject and cert_serial). Current audit entries are missing CN, which made triage slow. Suggest ENV flags and a config snippet for envoy filter:
```
- name: envoy.filters.network.tls_inspector
  typed_config:
    "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.network.tls_inspector.v3.TlsInspector
    include_client_cert_subject: true
    include_cert_serial_number: true
```
Please add to the edge proxy bootstrap and enable audit shipping to splunk: `AUDIT_CLIENT_SUBJECT=true`
Lina (sec-engineer): good. note: some services were using subjectAltName-only certs (SAN contains service-role but CN blank). New RBAC check demands CN present -> rejects. Rotator was issuing SAN-only certs after a recent template change. That's why KMS decrypt + cert shape both triggered.
Aisha (infra): quick mitigation: patch rotator to emit fallback CN of `svc-<name>` when CN missing, plus ensure KMS principal for rotator has kms:Decrypt on all regional aliases. Command to check cert on host: `openssl x509 -in /tmp/tls.crt -noout -subject -serial -ext subjectAltName`
Raj (platform): can we whitelist legacy identities in the RBAC rule for 24h while rotator patch lands? I can add `allow if subjectAltName == legacy/*` to the rule engine.
Maya (oncall): yes, do whitelist but log all matches. Create alert if whitelist used > 1% traffic for 30m.
Evan (sre): post-incident followups: 1) add unit test in rotator CI to reject SAN-only templates; 2) add an integration test that simulates RBAC policy tighten and confirms no mass rejects; 3) add KMS policy review step to deploy checklist.
Lina (sec-engineer): taking ownership of the postmortem write-up. short blameless timeline and action items: RBAC revert (done), rotator hotfix to restore CN (in PR #402), KMS policy patch applied to ap-south alias, envoy audit flags toggled, whitelist expiration enforcement.
Raj (platform): rollback succeeded in eu-west canary and error rate dropped by ~94% within 3 minutes. propagating to remaining nodes. will post deploy id here when done.
ops-bot: DEPLOY: rbac-revert v2 -> completed on eu-west-1 (deploy id d-99321).
Lina (sec-engineer): thanks team. next immediate items: schedule a quick runbook update for cert template changes, and add a Canary play that tests handshake after RBAC changes. I'll attach the log samples and the PR links in the doc. :thumbsup:
Maya (oncall): if anyone sees new handshake rejects after the full rollback, ping me and escalate to incident channel.
